thread:
alex: Quick check-in after today's inference latency outage — want to finalize owners for the postmortem action table.
mira: Yep. Can you recap the measurable impact?
alex: p99 token latency spiked to ~1.2s between 01:05-01:40 UTC for route /v1/generate-large. Throughput dipped 18% and daily error budget burned ~6.2%. Autoscaler policy didn't respond quickly enough.
diego: Observed node churn in nodepool-ml-2 plus a driver reconnect flurry. This matches two prior incidents in March.
chen: We should separate short-term mitigations vs longer-term fixes.
alex: Proposed split: (A) short-term SLO adjustment + comms (owner: mira, ETA: 12h), (B) autoscaler threshold & burst policy (owner: diego, ETA: 4d), (C) routing rule for very long sequences (owner: chen, ETA: 6d), (D) weekly recurrence tag + monthly review (owner: alex, ETA: 2d).
mira: I'll put the temporary SLO change in place: p99 for /v1/generate-large from 400ms -> 550ms for 48h and annotate SLO history. Will ping product.
diego: For autoscaler: change scale-up heuristic to trigger when queue > 250 or avg CPU > 60% for 30s, and enable a 90s warm-burst node pool. I'll bench with a synthetic load tomorrow.
chen: Routing: add an early-exit path for sequences > 3000 tokens to route to a low-latency dedicated pool; it requires a small router config and a perf job. I'll draft the PR.
postmortem-bot: PM ticket PM-1212 created and assigned. Postmortem due in 72h.
alex: Dashboards: need a rapid dashboard showing p50/p90/p99 by route, plus a burn-rate sparkline for error budget. Also add a "recurrence" flag to the postmortem metadata so ops can group repeat issues.
mira: I'll own the dashboard. Adding a Grafana panel and an alert when 10-min burn rate > 2%. ETA tomorrow EOD.
diego: I'll coordinate with infra re: driver updates and node replacements. If driver patch causes instability we'll migrate critical traffic to nodepool-ml-3 as a mitigation.
chen: Also adding a synthetic that runs every 4h which ramps seq lengths and reports tail latency. That should catch regressions earlier.
alex: Can someone add the PromQL we used for the quick triage?
mira: Adding it now: 
```
histogram_quantile(0.99, sum(rate(inference_request_latency_seconds_bucket[5m])) by (le, route, model))
```
diego: I'll run a 10k RPS replay and post results to PM-1212. If we still see hot-swap events, we'll open infra incident.
postmortem-bot: Tag added: recurrence=true.
mira: PR for dashboard: https://git.internal/grafana/pulls/1189 (draft).
chen: Router config RFC: https://docs.internal/rfcs/501 (WIP).
alex: Note on process: action grid rows must include owner, ETA, status, linked PR/ticket, and test evidence. We'll update PM-1212 after the sync.
diego: Agree. I'll attach the load test artifacts and perf graphs.
mira: I'll notify CS + product with a short pre-emptive note to avoid customer alerts.
chen: Let's meet for a quick 20-min handoff 09:00 UTC tomorrow.
alex: 09:00 works. Thanks everyone — please update the PM ticket with links and move actions to "in progress" when started.
